title: Persist SCHC tombstone duration in a restart-safe clock domain
description: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs serializes TerminalTombstone.until_ms as an absolute process-monotonic timestamp and restore_receiver_floor installs it unchanged after restart. Monotonic epochs are not comparable across processes: a new uptime already above the old value expires the replay hold-down immediately, while a reset-to-zero clock can extend it arbitrarily. Persist a restart-independent expiry or conservatively reconstruct a full hold-down from restore time, bind the representation into the sealed floor record, and add restart tests with lower and higher new clock values.
